text:
Assistant A provides a summary of the plot rather than an actual narrative opening. It tells the reader that the character is confused and has the ability to time travel, but it doesn't show any of it.

Assistant B actually writes a scene. It uses sensory details (sepia-toned room, muffled sounds) and a concrete plot device (the old phone) to demonstrate the time travel, creating a much more intriguing and professional opening for a story.

[[B]]
